name: Peg Powler

attributes.attribute: a green-haired spirit of the River Tees

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Peg Powler is a figure of British folklore. She is a green-haired spirit of the River Tees, between Durham and Yorkshire. She may be a worn-down form of an old Celtic river goddess of that area. She walked about, most often on Sundays, and lured the young and the old to a watery death. When foam gathered on the river, people called it Peg Powler's cream.

okr.objective: Describe Peg Powler as a river spirit of northern England.
key_results: Name Peg Powler as a green-haired spirit of the River Tees
